area: Kern River behind the Kern River Golf Course, northeast Bakersfield
summary: A caller reported that a woman had gone into the river and floated roughly an hour toward Lake Ming, with a blue and white raft mentioned in the call. The reporting party, who had been in the water with her, said both of them had gotten out and there was no reason she would have gone back toward the river. Crews searched the bank behind the Kern River Golf Course and later reported they had her, at a camp just southeast of the golf course area.

area: Rosedale Highway and canal bank area, Bakersfield
disposition: suspect detained; currency recovered; victim brought for identification
summary: Units went looking for a man with a satchel who was tracked southbound and then eastbound along a nearby street, heading toward the canal bank and Rosedale Highway. A caller reported that the man was discarding items near a chain link fence in a clearing by a tree. Officers reported recovering currency from the suspect and asked for the victim to be brought by for an in-field identification.

area: northbound Interstate 5 near the county line, Kern County
disposition: victim rig on the shoulder; suspect last seen northbound; CHP handling
summary: A hit and run was broadcast on northbound Interstate 5 just north of the county line: a Freightliner Cascadia pulling a trailer with damage to the passenger side struck a Kenworth whose occupants were on the right-hand shoulder. The suspect rig was last seen northbound. About two hours later a unit reported the victim vehicle was still on the shoulder, less than half a mile north of the county line.
A battalion and engine crews were sent to the 800 block of Exchange Street for a report of a back house or shed on fire, with people at the property trying to put it out.
A caller told dispatchers he had been knocked unconscious and was bleeding. An ambulance was requested to the 19th Street address.

area: East Cedar Street at Franklin Field, Bakersfield
summary: A unit was sent to check the welfare of a man reported to be at Franklin Field in a 2008 Ford Escape with a rope.
Units were sent for a vehicle versus pedestrian collision. The pedestrian was up and walking and did not appear to be injured.

area: southbound Interstate 5 north of the Grapevine, Kern County
summary: A white pickup with its hazard lights on was reported in the slow lane, and a short time later it was reported blocking the number 4 lane.

area: Edison Highway at the railroad tracks, east Bakersfield
summary: A caller reported fire seen from a distance in the Edison Highway area, and crews located a rubbish fire on the north side of the railroad tracks. Engine 41 reported it could handle, and the rest of the assignment was cancelled.

area: Sierra Highway mobile home park, eastern Kern County
summary: A 911 caller reported a suspected overdose at a mobile home park on Sierra Highway, and dispatchers worked to reach family members who were on scene.
Officers were sent for a priority verbal disturbance after a Spanish-speaking caller asked for law enforcement, with crying and screaming heard in the background.
A semi with a trailer was reported speeding and moving in and out of its lane, and dispatchers ran the trailer plate for a 2019 utility reefer out of Bakersfield.
